relationships.subject: Protectin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunofluorescence staining analysis further confirmed the significant increase in CGRP expression after NCLDH, which was dramatically downregulated by PD1 intervention on postoperative day 7

relationships.subject: Protectin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: The results demonstrated a significant decrease in SIRT1 following NCLDH and a dramatic upregulation after PD1 intervention

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis showed that both CGRP and NCLDH alone inhibited the protein level of SIRT1

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: EX527 treatment significantly upregulated CGRP expression, while SIRT1 activation by SRT1720 significantly downregulated CGRP expression in NCLDH rats

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: stimulation with CGRP elevated the protein levels of the inflammation-related cytokines TNF-α and IL-1β, as well as down-regulated the anti-inflammatory protein TGF-β

relationships.subject: CGRP 8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of CGRP 8-37 (CGRP antagonist) significantly increased PWT and PWL

relationships.subject: Protectin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal delivery of PD1 significantly reversed the NCLDH-induced imbalance in neuro-inflammatory response and alleviated the symptoms of mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia.

key_findings: Protectin D1 reduces spinal CGRP and restores SIRT1 in a rat non-compressive disc herniation model, relieving hyperalgesia.
SIRT1 and CGRP reciprocally suppress each other in spinal dorsal horn; CGRP drives TNF-α/IL-1β and suppresses TGF-β.
